purpose: First post-ds003944 falsification-oriented test in the Weltformel/MMSI validation battery. This experiment tests one narrow directional prediction of the frozen 19-channel friction observable; it is not a test of physical universality.

hypothesis_origin.frozen_interpretation: W is the model's normalized friction/load ratio. A sustained mental-arithmetic task is preregistered to produce a higher subject-level W than matched pre-task resting EEG.
exclusions: This experiment does not test OMEGA_KRIT=5800.
This experiment does not test mechanical vascular pressure, causal energy transfer, entropic gravity, diagnosis, or a universal physical law.

source.license: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0
source.cohort_rule: Use every complete Subject00 through Subject35 pair present in PhysioNet EEGMAT v1.0.0. No subject may be removed after MMSI outcomes are computed.
source.data_identity_rule: Download SHA256SUMS.txt from the pinned PhysioNet v1.0.0 path. For each of the 72 EDF files, resolve the filename's published SHA-256 and reject the file before analysis unless local SHA-256 matches exactly.

matched_input_rule.rationale: The public dataset contains a longer rest recording than arithmetic recording. Duration is matched before feature extraction so the primary comparison cannot be driven by unequal record length.
matched_input_rule.rest_window: first 60.0 seconds of the rest EDF after parser output
matched_input_rule.arithmetic_window: first 60.0 seconds of the arithmetic EDF after parser output
matched_input_rule.sample_count_rule: Require exactly 30000 samples per selected EEG channel at 500 Hz after slicing. Reject the subject pair as NOT_ANALYZABLE if either condition cannot supply this window.
matched_input_rule.finite_rule: Do not impute or tune. The frozen EDF parser output is passed unchanged except for deterministic 60-second slicing.

primary_endpoint.test: paired Wilcoxon signed-rank, one-sided arithmetic > rest, zero_method='wilcox', correction=false, asymptotic normal approximation
primary_endpoint.success_rule: Primary supported only if p_one_sided <= 0.05 and the sample median of delta_W is > 0.
effect_reporting: W_rest and W_arithmetic for every subject

secondary_predeclared_endpoints: paired change in each of the 19 localRatios
descriptive primary contrast stratified by published count-quality group; no subgroup result may replace the primary all-subject test

parity_gate.requirement: For every analyzable subject and condition, Kotlin ResearchFriction19Engine output must match an independently implemented Python oracle on the exact matched 60-second window before group inference.

guardrails: No EEGMAT MMSI W/Y/Z/coherence/local-ratio outcome may be inspected before this preregistration commit exists.
No subject, condition, channel, band, window, normalization constant, endpoint direction, statistical test, alpha or parity tolerance may change after outcomes are observed.
The published count-quality label is secondary only and may not be used to filter the primary cohort.
Failure of the primary directional test is retained unchanged and counts against generalization of the MMSI friction interpretation to this cognitive-load manipulation.
Success would support one narrow EEG-load prediction only. It would not establish OMEGA_KRIT, mechanical pressure coupling, diagnosis, metaphysical claims, universality, or a physical Weltformel.
